main.description: Open3D quadric-decimation + saturated vertex-color export to GLB. Reduces COLMAP raw mesh (50K-300K triangles) to ~5K triangles per tile so the kami-app-maps3d MeshTileAdapter can stream and upload to GPU without frame spikes. Per-vertex colors are saturated (factor 1.3, clamped) to bias the rendering toward Nintendo-style cel-shading rather than photoreal blur. Optionally segments the mesh by OSM building footprint so each building gets its own GLB + LanceDB spatial Building row (etzhayyim substrate per ADR-2605172000). PORT-adapted per ADR-2605214000 §2.

segmentByFootprint.description: When true, split into one GLB per OSM building. Default false (single tile GLB).

tileMeshUri.description: B2 URI of the simplified tile-level GLB.

buildings.description: Per-building outputs when segmentByFootprint=true, else empty.
